Tested 3 times? It's not strong. It's TIRED. 📊

Every time price comes back to a support, someone has to buy there. Those passive buy orders get filled and they don't come back for free. On the footprint you can see it: the bid volume at the level shrinks test after test, the bounces get smaller and delta weakens. When the 3rd test prints sell imbalances below the level, the liquidity is gone and the level breaks. The exception: a retest where bid volume grows again and delta flips positive means new buyers stepped in.

1️⃣ Count the tests and measure each bounce: 30 > 12 > 2 points is a warning
2️⃣ Shrinking bid volume at the level = passive buyers being used up
3️⃣ Stacked sell imbalances under the level = the break is starting
4️⃣ Bigger bids + delta flip on a retest = fresh buyers, the level can still hold
